# Proposals of the __TITLE__ domain

Schema change proposals that touch only this domain's files live here, one directory each, named
by its six-digit number (`000001/`): numbers are global across the core and the domain and are never
reused, and the title stays in `proposal.yaml`. `scale proposal new __DOMAIN__ --title "…"` allocates the
next number and scaffolds the directory. Kernel changes go to `core/proposals/`. How to
write one: `tools/skills/evolve-schema/SKILL.md`. An experimental domain changes by ordinary pull
request; proposals become required once it is stable.
